## Moderna Museet Collection

### What is your favorite work?

The Moderna Museet’s collection contains 140,000 works of modern and contemporary art. Here, you will find some of the world’s finest art, modern and contemporary, Swedish and international.

[Search the Collection](https://sis.modernamuseet.se/en/start)
